headline: Oil Prices Rise on Potential US Military Actions in Middle East
summary: Crude oil prices advanced after reports indicated Donald Trump was briefed on military options regarding potential US strikes against Iran.
why: Crude oil is the baseline energy commodity globally, and geopolitical tension in the Persian Gulf threatens major oil transit routes.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Threats of military action in key oil-producing regions raise supply disruption risks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Geopolitical escalation risks involving key Middle Eastern energy exporters drove up crude oil futures.
